options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (aria-describedby).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for values in tooltips, labels, the data table, the summary, and axis ticks (ticks use fixed fraction digits).

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere except axis ticks.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Ids of series (or slices) hidden initially; update() replaces the hidden set.

options.name: x
options.description: Shared x values, one per point: strings (category axis), numbers (linear axis), or instants (time axis). Numbers and instants must be ascending.

options.name: series
options.description: Series: { id, label, values: (number | null)[], color?: 1-8 }. values has exactly one entry per x value; null, NaN, and infinities are gaps.

options.name: area
options.description: Fill the area between each line and the zero baseline (includes zero in the domain).

options.name: xType
options.description: Axis type. Default: inferred from the first x value.

options.name: xAxis
options.description: X axis title and approximate tick count (2-20).

options.name: yAxis
options.type: { label?: string; tickCount?: number; min?: number; max?: number; includeZero?: boolean }
options.description: Y axis title, tick count, fixed domain, and zero inclusion (default true with area).

options.name: formatX
options.description: Custom x text for tooltips, labels, the table, and the summary.

options.name: timeFormat
options.description: Date format of time x values. Default: chosen from the data resolution (year, month, day, minute, second).

options.name: zoom
options.description: Zoom and pan along x: a Zoom toolbar (Zoom in, Zoom out, Reset zoom), +/= and - and 0 keys on a focused point, arrow keys past the window edge pan, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag to pan a zoomed chart, Shift + drag to select a range. Turning it off resets the window.

options.name: zoomRange
options.description: Visible x window { from, to } in data units (category index, number, or epoch ms for time axes); null shows everything. Clamped to the data and to at least two points. Applied without an aui-zoom event; use with zoom: true (the toolbar and keys need it).

options.name: annotations
options.description: Reference lines ({ type: 'line', axis: 'x' | 'y', value, label?, tone? }) and bands ({ type: 'band', axis, from, to, label?, tone? }); tone: 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'. x values are category labels or indexes, numbers, or epoch ms (time axes); y values are numbers. Drawn under the marks (aria-hidden); listed in the accessible summary.

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

options.name: legend
options.description: auto: legend when there is more than one series (pie charts: always).

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table fallback with the exact data: behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

options.name: patterns
options.description: Dash patterns and texture fills so series never differ by color alone. Off by default (plain colors); always on in forced colors. Turn it on when series are told apart by color alone (grouped or stacked series, multi-slice pies) and no labels carry the distinction (WCAG 1.4.1).

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

options.name: markers
options.description: Point markers: auto when points are at least 12 px apart; focus shows only the hovered or focused point. Isolated points always show a marker.

options.name: crosshair
options.description: Vertical crosshair line (aria-hidden) at the hovered or focused x value.

options.name: locale
options.description: Number, date, and message locale.

options.name: timezone
options.description: IANA timezone for time axes, tooltips, labels, and the table.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors the category/x axis, the value axis side, and Left/Right arrow keys.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

properties.name: hiddenSeries
properties.description: Ids of hidden series (slices for Pie Chart).

properties.name: zoomRange
properties.description: Current visible x window in data units, or null when showing everything.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. Keyboard focus stays on the same data point.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide a series (slice) programmatically; emits no event.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-series-toggle
events.detail: { id: string; visible: boolean; hidden: string[] }
events.description: The user toggled a legend entry (pointer or keyboard). Not emitted for update() or setSeriesVisible().

events.name: aui-zoom
events.detail: LineChartZoomDetail = ChartZoomDetail: { x: ChartZoomRange | null; y: null; reason: 'button' | 'keyboard' | 'wheel' | 'pan' | 'select' | 'reset' }
events.description: The user changed the visible window (toolbar, keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag pan, Shift + drag selection). x is null when showing everything. Not emitted for the zoomRange option or when the window does not change.

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: LineChartPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart

cssClasses.name: aui-line-chart

cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__grid / __gridline / __zero-line / __axis / __axis-line / __tick-label / __axis-title
cssClasses.description: Axes (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__series--c1 ... --c8
cssClasses.description: Palette slot classes; set --aui-chart-color from color-chart-<n>.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__dash--1 ... --4 / aui-chart__pattern / aui-chart__pattern-tile
cssClasses.description: Dash patterns and texture overlays.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__mark / __mark--active / __mark--hover
cssClasses.description: Focusable data mark and its states.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__value-label
cssClasses.description: Printed values with a surface-colored halo.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-rows / __tooltip-row / __tooltip-label / __tooltip-value
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused mark carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty
cssClasses.description: Empty state text (No data, All series are hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__summary
cssClasses.description: Hidden summary referenced by aria-describedby.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__data / __data--hidden / __table-toggle / __table-scroll / __table / __cell--numeric
cssClasses.description: Data table fallback.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--zoomable / aui-chart--zoomed
cssClasses.description: Host modifiers: zoom enabled (touch-action pan-y on the body); a window is applied (grab cursor).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__toolbar / __zoom / __tool
cssClasses.description: Header toolbar (hidden while empty), the Zoom button group, and its icon buttons (aria-disabled when unavailable).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__crosshair / __crosshair-line
cssClasses.description: aria-hidden crosshair line drawn under the marks (crosshair option).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__brush
cssClasses.description: Range-selection rectangle while Shift + dragging.

cssClasses.name: aui-line-chart--markers / --area
cssClasses.description: Markers visible; area fill on.

cssClasses.name: aui-line-chart__series / __line / __area / __points / __point / __point--isolated / __markers / __cursor
cssClasses.description: Series group, line, area, point marks, isolated point, dense-series marker path, and the proxy mark of dense series.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--legend-bottom / --legend-start / --legend-end
cssClasses.description: theme.legendPosition (top is the default layout).

cssClasses.description: Annotations (aria-hidden), drawn under the marks.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__gradient / __gradient-stop
cssClasses.description: Gradient fills (theme.gradient).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip--custom
cssClasses.description: Tooltip content comes from renderTooltip.
